name: 27537 · Henderson, NC
findings: ZIP 27537 (Henderson) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27537 (Henderson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27537 (Henderson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
